column1: # Small-file size pins: OUR exact gzip output size per (fixture, size,
# level) at -p 1 — the sub-1-MiB grid the board never grades, but the
# high-frequency real-world case. Inputs are 4Ki/16Ki/64Ki/256Ki prefixes
# gzip_bytes / pigz_bytes are INFORMATIONAL ONLY: recorded from the local
# CLIs (versions on the tools line below) at regen time, '-' when absent.
# The test asserts ONLY ours_bytes; it prints ours-vs-gzip deltas so the
# competitive picture stays visible. A losing delta is a finding to flag
# in a PR, not a failure.
# Wall at small sizes is startup-dominated and needs box grading — out of
# scope here; this file pins SIZE only.
